import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
ims=[np.asarray(Image.open(p/f'f{i}.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=np.int16) for i in range(5)]
a=ims[0]
lum=a.mean(axis=2)
out={'size':[int(a.shape[1]),int(a.shape[0])], 'mean_rgb':[round(float(x),3) for x in a.mean(axis=(0,1))], 'std_rgb':[round(float(x),3) for x in a.std(axis=(0,1))], 'black_frac':round(float((lum<5).mean()),6), 'white_frac':round(float((lum>250).mean()),6)}
pairs=[]
for x,y in zip(ims,ims[1:]):
 d=np.abs(y-x).mean(axis=2)
 pairs.append({'mad':round(float(d.mean()),4),'changed_gt2_frac':round(float((d>2).mean()),6),'changed_gt8_frac':round(float((d>8).mean()),6)})
out['consecutive_frame_diffs']=pairs
out['dynamic_any']=any(q['changed_gt2_frac']>0.01 for q in pairs)
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
if out['black_frac']>0.95 or out['white_frac']>0.95: raise SystemExit('near-uniform catastrophic frame')
if not out['dynamic_any']: raise SystemExit('no measurable visual dynamics across live captures')
PY
